    Ray categories without contours have monomial linearizations #

    A finite ray category P has no contours (NoContour) if two directed paths of Q_P with the same nonzero value are equal. Then the kernel of the presentation kQ_P → k(P) is spanned by the words of the paths with zero value (ker_linPres_le): the linearization is a zero-relation algebra.
